arabic: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
translation: Whoever says: none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Alone, without partner, His is the dominion and His the praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent — a hundred times in a day — will have the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds recorded, a hundred bad deeds erased, and protection from Satan till evening.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, Glory be to Allah the Magnificent.

arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
translation: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him.
